_comment: The test party, made by every target's harness through character creation. A question takes the preferred labels it offers (`A:` means an equipment choice starting with it), then its first choices up to the count; ability scores stay as offered.

characters.name: Tester
characters.about: A level 1 Wizard: spells (a prepared caster with a spellbook), a Human whose Versatile trait picks an origin feat, the Sage's Magic Initiate.

characters.name: Brawler
characters.about: A level 1 Monk: Martial Arts and monk weapons, a subspecies (from the invented supplement), a gaming set picked from the Soldier's equipment.

characters.name: Hexa
characters.about: A level 1 Warlock: pact magic and invocations, an Elf lineage, a feat with versions (the Acolyte's Magic Initiate; Cleric), a holy symbol picked from the equipment.

characters.name: Ranger
characters.about: A level 1 Ranger: a half caster with weapon masteries and Favored Enemy, a Tiefling legacy.
